report.speaker: David Pérez-García
report.title: The Quest for a Classification of 2D Quantum Phases of Matter
report.question: 有限程二维量子模型为何无法普遍算法分类，而张量网络的体边结构又如何支持从平面基态恢复拓扑激发？
report.reading_scope:
perez-garcia-icm2026: Entire publisher HTML: abstract, mathematical §§1–6, every displayed formula, all bibliography entries [1]–[64], acknowledgments and copyright/publication metadata, read in overlapping section-sized passes. All 15 inline tensor-diagram images were opened and visually inspected individually in the browser. No report PDF edition was read. §§2–3 were rechecked during final authoring. For revision 2, reread Theorem 2.3 clauses 2–3 and the following undecidability consequence, and §§5.1.1–5.2 including Definitions 5.2, 5.3, 5.5 and equations (5.1)–(5.3); checked the corresponding note locators against those passages.
haag-duality-v2: v2 abstract and §1; all §2.1 including Lemma 2.1.4 proof; §2.2 Assumption 2.2.1, Remark 2.2.2 and Lemma 2.2.3 statement plus selected proof paragraphs, not the whole proof; §3.1 definitions through dual/trivial representations; §3.4 Definitions 3.4.1–3.4.5; §3.5 Theorem 3.5.3 and selected proof text; §3.6 main theorem, Lemma 3.6.3 uses and proof conclusion; §3.7 Theorem 3.7.1 and beginning of its proof; §4.1 theorem statements and finite-map formulas through Corollary 4.1.6, plus beginning of §4.2. Earlier v1 was also read for these themes and §3.4 tensor conventions, but final theorem contracts are bound to v2. The 70-page paper and its 166 figures were not read in full; no full appendix reading claimed.
cubitt-gap-v5: Version metadata/abstract; PDF introductory definitions of strong gapped/gapless and initial Theorem 3 (printed pp.5–6); restatement and final assembly excerpt in §6.2 (printed pp.140–142). Independently read publisher PDF pages 4 and 96 via text extraction from existing parent-provided /tmp/cubitt-undecidability-2022.pdf to verify alpha≤beta versus alpha≤2beta. Not the full 150-page proof. Web PDF screenshot calls failed; no visual-PDF inspection by this author is claimed.
levin-wen-v2: Abstract/version metadata and introduction excerpt; HTML §IV.B fixed-point Hamiltonians, equations (10)–(14), coefficient choice d_s/sum d_i^2 and listed commuting-projector consequences. Full appendices, F-symbol graphical proofs and generalized models were not read.
ogata-sectors-v1: Version metadata and license; PDF text of §1.3 Definition 1.5 and following main-result summary (printed p.5), §2 Setting 2.1 and equations (2.1)–(2.2) (printed p.6), Lemma 2.2 and beginning of Definition 2.3. egno-2015-author-final: Title/copyright pages; Definition 4.1.1 and Examples 4.1.2–4.1.3, printed p.65 (PDF page 82); Proposition 4.2.1 and Remark 4.2.2, p.66 (PDF page 83); Remark 9.4.7 on Hermitian and unitary fusion categories, pp.283–284 (PDF pages 300–301). local-calculations: Local proofs in the notes: finite spectral/projection identities, halting diagonal reduction, restricted binary Busy Beaver simulation, GNS, finite tensor commutants, MPS/PEPS annihilation, pseudoinverse image projection, cut-rank bound, four-leg regular-group contractions on finite square-lattice regions, boundary rank, polarization, conditional plane uniqueness, decreasing projections, Pauli toric-code counting, string endpoints, and intertwiner tensor composition. Revision 2 recomputes physical Z2 four-leg tensor contractions for path3 and square4 with all eight boundary legs, rather than the superseded two-boundary group-label expansion.

4I01.scope: 固定 d、图距离、平移不变及均匀有界；区分粒子数和几何程。

4I02.scope: 有限体积不同能级间隔；允许简并，标量 Hamiltonian 取无穷；一致体积下界。

4I03.scope: 固定共同程和连续性约定，谱隙同时对 L 与 s 一致；常值、反向、拼接证明等价关系。

4I04.scope: 有限维谱分解证明零期望迫使每个正项湮灭；给出无挫折的零能约定。

4I05.scope: 明确有限维空间；共同投影、同时特征基、正权重下界；简并允许。

4I06.scope: 停机对角论证完整；通用模拟和空白输入编码的构造说明，不重建通用机完整转移表。

4I07.scope: Theorem 2.3 的整数矩阵、代数 alpha≤beta、相位因子、局部范数≤1；停机仅最终有隙，非停机为强谱稠密。

4I08.scope: 以引用构造为输入，完整证明可计算归约；不停机输入属于强无隙分支，不对分支比例作断言；不将有隙承诺分类猜想当成结论。

4I09.scope: 二符号、仅左右移动、单一停机态、空白输入模型；有限字母编码、有效状态数、模拟上界矛盾。BB(6) 塔界仅作为报告历史下界。

4I0A.scope: d=10、R=2、L0≥BB(6)，两侧 gap≥1；尺寸转换与参数路径分开；不把此有限边界模型等同于周期四维例子。

4I0B.scope: 逐输入有隙且两种固定相由停机二分，保留为 Conjecture 3.1。

4I0C.scope: 局部矩阵代数嵌入、范数完成；不交支撑的交换性由有限级及范数极限证明。

4I0E.scope: 抽象极点定义和凸组合正性；与完整矩阵秩一刻画分为独立页面。

4I0F.scope: Schwarz 给出零空间线性和商内积；抽象 C* 二项式正元界给左理想、有界表示；内积完成与循环酉唯一性。

remaining_branches.scope: Conjectures 3.1 and 3.2 remain conjectural. No formal resolution of nonchirality, generic representative existence or completeness of anyon invariants is asserted.

Axioms and biconnectedness are defined; the §3.4 family is identified by its exact primary source, not reconstructed coefficient by coefficient. General MPO tensors, weights, integral elements, faithful representation choices and tensor-diagram manipulations remain a research branch.

remaining_branches.branch: Phase invariance and quantum-double sector identification
remaining_branches.scope: The report discussion of approximate duality invariance, full braided C* categories, equivalence with representations of D(G), and same-category string-net phase equivalence is contextual. Exact contracts and proofs of report references [9], [35], [44] are not independently developed here.

Rotationally symmetric and 1D spectral undecidability, quantum-hardness of phase recognition, symmetry-protected classifications, entanglement bootstrap and Hall conductance are contextual, not separate fully developed branches.
Busy Beaver height-10^7 decimal tower is attributed to the report as a historical lower bound in its exact binary model, not a current-record claim.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Undecidable Hamiltonian construction, quantum phase estimation/history Hamiltonians, tiling hierarchy, explicit d=10 size-driven model and perturbative stability are quoted research results. Only halting and reduction logic is proved locally.

General weighted weak-Hopf bulk-boundary, intersection, local indistinguishability, two-dimensional operator transfer and cone geometry proofs are cited. One-dimensional diagrams are illustrations, never the full general proof.

Rieffel–van Daele theorem, factor compression faithfulness/lifting, and finite-to-infinite error analysis are cited. All usable hypotheses are recorded, and elementary decomposition is separately proved.

Sector selection and elementary intertwiner tensor structure are explicit; transport-independent braiding, rigidity/semisimplicity of physical sectors, categorical dimension theory and general F-symbol pentagon/projector calculations are not reconstructed.

metadata.coverage: All six report sections have developed mathematical entries, with 48 atomic questions. Three additional foundational atoms distinguish weak Hopf structure, fusion categories and rank-one purity. Entire report read independently; selected research supplements version-bound. EGNO author-final 2015 book passages additionally support the fusion definition.
metadata.model_conventions: Open finite boxes for general spin definitions; excitation gap above full ground eigenspace. Path gap uniform in s and L. Regular-group networks use four legs at each vertex of a finite connected square-lattice region, every unused leg retained as boundary, 4n=2m+b, unnormalized bonds and Gram factor D^(m-n+1). Path3 and square4 both have b=8. Toric code separately L≥3 periodic with edge qubits and penalty (I-stabilizer)/2, ground dimension4 and gap2. Approximate original-lattice versus exact 2x2-blocked Haag duality distinguished.

source_errata.resolution: 4I01 uses diameter in graph distance, not cardinality of support; a two-site arbitrarily-separated counterexample is explicit.
Initial/report alpha≤beta and restatement alpha≤2beta both recorded. No global reconciliation or changed theorem constant claimed.

Printed cone sandwich repeats C_kappa-prime on both sides and paths are described as disjoint despite a common apex. Notes avoid supplying an unverified corrected general definition; use exact blocked-cone case and refer broader stepped-cone domain to the primary theorem.

4I0Y retains the bounded common error requirement and uniform operator-input estimates. 4I12 states the verified large-N zero-error identities; it does not infer a global bounded error from growing finite-map norms or claim to reconstruct the limiting proof.

source_records.copyright: 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM
source_records.actual_reading: Entire publisher HTML: abstract, mathematical §§1–6, every displayed formula, all bibliography entries [1]–[64], acknowledgments and copyright/publication metadata, read in overlapping section-sized passes. All 15 inline tensor-diagram images were opened and visually inspected individually in the browser. No report PDF edition was read. §§2–3 were rechecked during final authoring. For revision 2, reread Theorem 2.3 clauses 2–3 and the following undecidability consequence, and §§5.1.1–5.2 including Definitions 5.2, 5.3, 5.5 and equations (5.1)–(5.3); checked the corresponding note locators against those passages.
source_records.proof_boundary: Full report reading does not imply full proofs of imported research theorems. Notes explicitly separate local finite proofs, quoted research statements, conditional reductions and conjectures. No source diagrams are reproduced.

source_records.license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license, not CC BY
source_records.actual_reading: v2 abstract and §1; all §2.1 including Lemma 2.1.4 proof; §2.2 Assumption 2.2.1, Remark 2.2.2 and Lemma 2.2.3 statement plus selected proof paragraphs, not the whole proof; §3.1 definitions through dual/trivial representations; §3.4 Definitions 3.4.1–3.4.5; §3.5 Theorem 3.5.3 and selected proof text; §3.6 main theorem, Lemma 3.6.3 uses and proof conclusion; §3.7 Theorem 3.7.1 and beginning of its proof; §4.1 theorem statements and finite-map formulas through Corollary 4.1.6, plus beginning of §4.2. Earlier v1 was also read for these themes and §3.4 tensor conventions, but final theorem contracts are bound to v2. The 70-page paper and its 166 figures were not read in full; no full appendix reading claimed.

source_records.title: Tensor Categories
source_records.version: 2015 author-final book PDF, printed pagination; URL is not an arXiv-version identifier
source_records.license: Copyright 2015 American Mathematical Society, all rights reserved; author-final version made available with publisher permission. Not a Creative Commons license.
source_records.actual_reading: Title/copyright pages; Definition 4.1.1 and Examples 4.1.2–4.1.3, printed p.65 (PDF page 82); Proposition 4.2.1 and Remark 4.2.2, p.66 (PDF page 83); Remark 9.4.7 on Hermitian and unitary fusion categories, pp.283–284 (PDF pages 300–301). Selected PDF text read independently, not the entire book. The numbered item 4.2.2 is a Remark, not an Example.
source_records.proof_boundary: 4I1B states the finite semisimple C*-category form, explicitly including all finite biproducts and a complex-bilinear tensor bifunctor. Standard rigidity/dimension theory is not proved locally; no book pages or long prose are reproduced.

source_records.actual_reading: Local proofs in the notes: finite spectral/projection identities, halting diagonal reduction, restricted binary Busy Beaver simulation, GNS, finite tensor commutants, MPS/PEPS annihilation, pseudoinverse image projection, cut-rank bound, four-leg regular-group contractions on finite square-lattice regions, boundary rank, polarization, conditional plane uniqueness, decreasing projections, Pauli toric-code counting, string endpoints, and intertwiner tensor composition. Revision 2 recomputes physical Z2 four-leg tensor contractions for path3 and square4 with all eight boundary legs, rather than the superseded two-boundary group-label expansion.
source_records.proof_boundary: Exhaustive finite checks corroborate examples but do not establish general research theorems. The prior b=2 numerical examples do not test the four-leg model and are withdrawn as evidence for it.

remaining_branches.scope: Conjectures 3.1 and 3.2 remain conjectural. No formal resolution of nonchirality, generic representative existence or completeness of anyon invariants is asserted.

Axioms and biconnectedness are defined; the §3.4 family is identified by its exact primary source, not reconstructed coefficient by coefficient. General MPO tensors, weights, integral elements, faithful representation choices and tensor-diagram manipulations remain a research branch.

remaining_branches.branch: Phase invariance and quantum-double sector identification
remaining_branches.scope: The report discussion of approximate duality invariance, full braided C* categories, equivalence with representations of D(G), and same-category string-net phase equivalence is contextual. Exact contracts and proofs of report references [9], [35], [44] are not independently developed here.

Rotationally symmetric and 1D spectral undecidability, quantum-hardness of phase recognition, symmetry-protected classifications, entanglement bootstrap and Hall conductance are contextual, not separate fully developed branches.
Busy Beaver height-10^7 decimal tower is attributed to the report as a historical lower bound in its exact binary model, not a current-record claim.

unexpanded_deep_proofs.scope: Undecidable Hamiltonian construction, quantum phase estimation/history Hamiltonians, tiling hierarchy, explicit d=10 size-driven model and perturbative stability are quoted research results. Only halting and reduction logic is proved locally.

General weighted weak-Hopf bulk-boundary, intersection, local indistinguishability, two-dimensional operator transfer and cone geometry proofs are cited. One-dimensional diagrams are illustrations, never the full general proof.

Rieffel–van Daele theorem, factor compression faithfulness/lifting, and finite-to-infinite error analysis are cited. All usable hypotheses are recorded, and elementary decomposition is separately proved.

Sector selection and elementary intertwiner tensor structure are explicit; transport-independent braiding, rigidity/semisimplicity of physical sectors, categorical dimension theory and general F-symbol pentagon/projector calculations are not reconstructed.

source_errata.resolution: 4I01 uses diameter in graph distance, not cardinality of support; a two-site arbitrarily-separated counterexample is explicit.
Initial/report alpha≤beta and restatement alpha≤2beta both recorded. No global reconciliation or changed theorem constant claimed.

Printed cone sandwich repeats C_kappa-prime on both sides and paths are described as disjoint despite a common apex. Notes avoid supplying an unverified corrected general definition; use exact blocked-cone case and refer broader stepped-cone domain to the primary theorem.

4I0Y retains the bounded common error requirement and uniform operator-input estimates. 4I12 states the verified large-N zero-error identities; it does not infer a global bounded error from growing finite-map norms or claim to reconstruct the limiting proof.
